purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) to support joins against flight event tables and weather-driven delay analysis.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (the declared grain) to attach weather context to flight records; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or average values, and should expect wind_gust to be populated only about 25% of the time.
limitations: No deduplication logic was needed since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, but wind_gust (74.6% null) and pressure (11.5% null) remain sparsely populated and were not imputed; precision for decimal measurement columns was narrowed from the landed DECIMAL(38,9) based on observed sample precision, which a reviewer should confirm against source instrument precision before approval.
